projects.name: MeshMotion
projects.shortDescription: Advanced 3D GLB animation viewer with professional controls
projects.fullDescription: Advanced GLB Animation Viewer built with Next.js 15, React Three Fiber, and TypeScript. Enables users to load, preview, and manipulate 3D models with professional-grade animation controls. Features glassmorphism aesthetics, GLB animation playback, animation retargeting for Mixamo assets, professional lighting systems, timeline editing with frame-level control, and multiple material visualization modes.
features: Multiple material visualization modes (Textured, Clay, Wireframe, X-Ray, PBR)
Playback controls (play/pause, speed adjustment, looping, timeline scrubbing)
Multiple lighting presets (Studio, Soft, Dramatic, Outdoor, Custom)

projects.name: AnalyticsMind
projects.shortDescription: AI-powered Google Analytics platform with intelligent insights and custom dashboards
projects.fullDescription: AnalyticsMind is a next-generation Google Analytics platform that combines the power of AI (Anthropic Claude & OpenAI) with advanced data visualization to deliver actionable insights. Built with Next.js 15 and modern technologies, it transforms raw GA4 data into intelligent, customizable dashboards with drag-and-drop widgets, automated reporting, and AI-powered analysis that helps businesses make data-driven decisions faster.
features: AI-powered insights with Claude & GPT models
Export dashboards to PDF with custom branding
Advanced filtering, segmentation, and date comparisons

projects.name: WorldTime
projects.shortDescription: Elegant world clock and timezone converter for global teams
projects.fullDescription: A beautiful and intuitive world clock application designed for remote teams and international collaboration. Features real-time timezone conversion, meeting scheduler, and visual time comparison to help coordinate across different time zones effortlessly.
features: Real-time world clock with multiple timezones
Smart timezone converter with DST support
Meeting time finder for multiple locations

projects.name: Datos Abiertos
projects.shortDescription: Spanish government open data visualization platform
projects.fullDescription: Web application that makes Spain's Official State Bulletin (BOE) accessible through an interactive visualization platform. Built with Nuxt.js 3, Vue 3, Tailwind CSS, and Nitro. Features intuitive search with date range filtering, visual calendar selection, intelligent organization grouping bulletins by weeks, cross-platform responsive design, and analytics tools including statistics and distribution graphs.
features: Intuitive search with date range filtering and visual calendar selection
Intelligent organization grouping bulletins by weeks with hierarchical navigation
Cross-platform responsive design supporting mobile, tablets, and screen readers
Analytics tools including statistics, distribution graphs, and temporal trends
Intelligent cache system with lazy loading and prefetching

projects.name: Experimental Lab
projects.shortDescription: Interactive playground for experimenting with cutting-edge web technologies
projects.fullDescription: A living showcase of experimental web projects and proof-of-concepts. This lab serves as a sandbox environment for testing emerging web technologies, design patterns, and innovative UI/UX concepts before integrating them into production applications.

projects.name: iruhernandez.com
projects.shortDescription: Modern Vue 3 portfolio with custom features
projects.fullDescription: Modern Vue 3 portfolio by Iru Hernández showcasing frontend development work. Features clean, professional interface matching production site with dark/light theme toggling and an infinite carousel for project displays. Includes responsive mobile-first design, performance optimization with service worker readiness, semantic HTML for SEO, and infinite loop scroll carousel supporting mouse wheel and drag interactions with snap-to-center functionality.
features: Dark/light theme toggling with system preference detection
Infinite carousel with mouse wheel and drag interactions
Performance optimization with service worker readiness
GitHub service integration for displaying real projects

projects.name: Three.js Portfolio
projects.fullDescription: Portfolio created with Three.js and Vite. A 3D portfolio showcasing work using Three.js library for 3D graphics and visualizations in the browser.

projects.name: Metricool
projects.shortDescription: All-in-one social media analytics and management platform trusted by 2M+ users
projects.fullDescription: Metricool is the definitive all-in-one tool for managing and analyzing social media presence across all major platforms. Trusted by over 2 million users worldwide, it provides comprehensive analytics, scheduling, and ad management capabilities for businesses, agencies, and content creators.
features: Unified analytics across 10+ social networks (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, Twitter, YouTube, Pinterest)
Advanced content scheduling with best time to post recommendations
AI-powered content assistant for caption generation
Unified inbox managing all social interactions in one place
Ad campaign management for Facebook, Instagram, Google, and TikTok
Custom white-label reports with automated generation
Team collaboration tools with role-based permissions
projects.contribution: Led development of analytics dashboards, real-time data visualization, content scheduling system, and cross-platform mobile app. Optimized performance for handling millions of social media metrics daily.
achievements: Part of frontend team that started with 3 developers and scaled to 12
Implemented real-time analytics processing 10M+ metrics daily
Reduced dashboard load time by 60% through optimization
Built responsive charts handling datasets with 100k+ data points

projects.name: Metricool Mobile App
projects.shortDescription: Cross-platform mobile app for social media analytics with 500k+ downloads
projects.fullDescription: Official Metricool mobile application providing full-featured social media analytics and management on iOS and Android. Built with cross-platform technologies to deliver native performance while maintaining a single codebase, serving over 500,000 active users.
features: Complete analytics dashboard optimized for mobile
Post scheduling with image editor and preview
Push notifications for metric alerts and milestones
Native camera integration for content creation
projects.contribution: Architected and developed cross-platform mobile application from scratch using Ionic and Capacitor. Implemented offline-first architecture, real-time sync, push notifications system, and native device integrations for both iOS and Android platforms.
achievements: 500k+ combined downloads on iOS and Android
4.5+ star rating on both app stores
Reduced app size by 40% through optimization

projects.name: MyoLab Self
projects.shortDescription: Cutting-edge embodied AI platform creating personalized human digital twins
projects.fullDescription: MyoLab Self is a revolutionary embodied AI platform that creates personalized human digital twins with embodied intelligence. The platform accurately predicts an individual's physiology, cognition, and behavior to enable hyper-personalized experiences in health, search, and e-commerce. Building human-embodied intelligence to empower humans.
features: Real-time 3D embodied avatars with musculoskeletal models
Interactive emotional and physical expression systems
Personalized digital twin creation and customization
Human-like AI interactions with natural language processing
projects.contribution: Architected and built the entire frontend application for MyoLab's embodied AI platform. Implemented real-time 3D avatar rendering, emotional expression systems, and complex WebGL visualizations. Collaborated directly with AI/ML team to integrate embodied intelligence models into interactive user experiences.
achievements: Built 3D rendering engine handling complex skeletal animations
Implemented real-time expression system with 60fps performance
Optimized WebGL shaders reducing GPU load by 45%

projects.name: MyoLab Demo
projects.shortDescription: Interactive showcase demonstrating embodied AI capabilities and use cases
projects.fullDescription: Interactive demonstration platform showcasing MyoLab's embodied AI technology and its practical applications. Features live demos of digital twin creation, predictive modeling, and personalized AI interactions across various use cases including health optimization, movement analysis, and cognitive behavioral predictions.
projects.contribution: Developed interactive demo experiences showcasing MyoLab's embodied AI technology. Created engaging visualizations and interactive scenarios demonstrating real-world applications of human digital twins in healthcare, fitness, and personalized recommendations.

projects.name: Kinephy Canvas
projects.shortDescription: AI-powered animation creation platform with intelligent motion generation
projects.fullDescription: Kinephy Canvas is an innovative AI-powered animation platform that combines traditional animation tools with cutting-edge AI motion generation. projects.contribution: Developed the canvas-based animation editor and AI tooling interface. Implemented real-time rendering system, timeline editor, and integration with AI motion generation models. Built intuitive controls for AI-assisted animation creation.
achievements: Implemented undo/redo system with efficient state management
Integrated AI models for real-time motion prediction
